text: {"lessons":["Monthly account moves have been modest so far; I should avoid reacting to every fluctuation and keep my long-term living needs in view.","Selling Stock E at a loss taught me not to let a falling price alone drive a decision; I should weigh the reasons for holding it and my overall plan.","Repeatedly trimming Stock D after gains has reduced some exposure, but I should base future trades on risk and allocation—not just past gains—and avoid unnecessary frequent trading."]}
